profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full stack software developer with experience across automotive, fintech, healthcare, and financial service domains developing large scale production systems with strict availability requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Technical lead for Toyota's smartphone projection platform, owning the CarPlay and Android Auto front end implementation across multiple vehicle programs and head unit hardware variants.
- Lead a team of up to 6 engineers owning the projection stack end to end, from architecture through production release.
- Architect the projection UI layer in Flutter/Dart against embedded constraints, supporting multiple hardware generations from a shared codebase.
- Partner with platform, hardware, and validation teams across regions to deliver against vehicle program milestones.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Consultant II)
positions.description:
Automotive Client:
- Backend developer working with Java Springboot and Go
- Front end developer working with Flutter and Dart
- Developed improvements to Gitlab CI improving validation build times by 80%

Fintech Client - Developer: 
- Backend developer working with JavaScript and Python. 
- Integrated new credit bureau vendor API to expand decision funnel strategy. 
- Developed REST API to update and reference dynamic parameters and postgresql database.
- Developed GitLabCI continuous integration to automate regression for a 70% reduction in cycle time.
- Integrated postman automation with Snowflake data sources.
- Set up observability for new product engines with DataDog and Elasticsearch Kibana

Financial Services Client - DevOps Engineer: 
 - Audited implementation of an underwriting decision engine built in JavaScript; assessed resiliency, test practices, scalability of architecture, and build accuracy.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented an automated test suite for front end feature testing and regression using Pytest, Cucumber, and Selenium, running as distributed tests through SauceLabs.
- Transitioned reliability teams to Behavior Driven Development and integrated Cucumber to define test scripts in Gherkin BDD.
- Developed ElasticSearch Kibana capabilities to add live monitoring and improve root cause analysis.

positions.title: Summer Intern 2018, 2019
positions.description:
- Developed automated instrument scripts for FCC compliance testing of over the air systems referencing the 3GPP 5G standard using Python, Bash, and SCPI.
 - Designed and implemented a python application to calculate and transmit beam form signals for mMIMO antenna array with health logging features and a graphical UI for real time monitoring.
